commands.command:
set -eu
install -d -m 0755 /usr/local/libexec
cat > /usr/local/libexec/help-site-server.py <<'PY_EOF'
#!/usr/bin/python3
from http.server import SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

ROOT = "/srv/legacy2/permanent-url-migration"

class HelpHandler(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, directory=ROOT, **kwargs)

    def _redirect_legacy_manual(self):
        request = urlsplit(self.path)
        if request.path == "/manual" or request.path.startswith("/manual/"):
            suffix = request.path[len("/manual"):]
            if not suffix:
                suffix = "/"
            location = "/help" + suffix
            if request.query:
                location += "?" + request.query
            self.send_response(301)
            self.send_header("Location", location)
            self.send_header("Content-Length", "0")
            self.end_headers()
            return True
        return False

    def do_GET(self):
        if not self._redirect_legacy_manual():
            super().do_GET()

    def do_HEAD(self):
        if not self._redirect_legacy_manual():
            super().do_HEAD()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8080), HelpHandler).serve_forever()
PY_EOF
chmod 0755 /usr/local/libexec/help-site-server.py
cat > /etc/systemd/system/help-site.service <<'UNIT_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Help site with permanent legacy URL redirects
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /usr/local/libexec/help-site-server.py
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2
User=nobody
Group=nobody
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectHome=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectKernelTunables=true
ProtectKernelModules=true
ProtectControlGroups=true

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT_EOF
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now help-site.service
firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=8080/tcp
firewall-cmd --add-port=8080/tcp
printf '%s\n' 'service and firewall configured'
